blockers.message: the review record has no `## code.review` section, while roles were active at it
R-skeptic-1 (The plan targets CLI files that do not exist in this repository) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.recommendation: Verify where `ledger import` and its progress output actually live (the crate holds only `src/lib.rs`, `src/api.rs` and `src/db.rs`, a library with no CLI and no `docs/` folder) and re-anchor the Impact, the design's Context and the tasks on the real files, or state that the CLI must be created first.
findings.title: The plan targets CLI files that do not exist in this repository

findings.evidence:
`ledger import` prints one progress line per 1 000 rows on standard error
through `src/cli/progress.rs`; errors go through `src/cli/errors.rs`, a
separate path.
findings.recommendation: Confirm that progress and errors really take separate paths in the code (neither `src/cli/progress.rs` nor `src/cli/errors.rs` exists); the decision that errors "cannot be silenced by mistake" holds only if this is true.
findings.title: The design rests on an unverified description of the progress and error paths

findings.evidence: - [ ] 1.2 Document `--quiet` in `docs/cli.md`, verified by `cargo test docs_mention_every_flag`
findings.recommendation: Add a task that writes `docs_mention_every_flag`, or name an observable check that exists today; as written the task cannot be verified.
findings.title: Task 1.2 is verified by a test that does not exist and that no task creates

findings.evidence: - **THEN** nothing is printed and the exit code is 0
findings.recommendation: Align the scenario with the requirement ("no progress line on standard error"), or state that standard output is also silent; otherwise a summary line on stdout, or a warning, would make the test fail or the requirement ambiguous.
findings.title: The scenario "nothing is printed" is broader than the requirement

findings.evidence: `ledger import --quiet` SHALL print no progress line on standard error; errors SHALL still be printed, and the exit code SHALL be unchanged.
findings.recommendation: Say whether non-fatal messages (skipped rows, warnings) are silenced by `--quiet`; nightly scripts likely still want them, and the spec covers only success and a fatal error.
findings.title: Warnings are classified neither as progress nor as errors
